item.title: Brands must blend first-party and streaming insights with creative instinct: Priyanka Khaneja Gandhi
item.description: New Delhi: Amazon Ads India has outlined five advertising trends it expects will reshape how brands connect with Indian consumers in 2026, driven by a mix of AI-led workflows, sharper audience insight, streaming TV’s shift to performance, and creator-led authenticity. item.title: India AI Impact Summit 2026: Expo entry restricted on Feb 16; opens to all from Feb 17
item.description: New Delhi: Entry to the India AI Impact Summit 2026 will be restricted on the first day, while the India AI Impact Expo 2026 will open to all visitors from February 17, according to an official advisory issued on Sunday. item.title: AI Impact Summit kicks off in Delhi; CEOs and ministers gather at Bharat Mandapam
item.description: New Delhi: India on Monday began hosting the five-day AI Impact Summit at Bharat Mandapam, bringing together global political leaders, technology CEOs, policymakers and researchers as countries intensify efforts to shape Artificial Intelligence policy, standards and adoption. item.description: New Delhi: Tata Communications on Monday unveiled a new corporate brand identity and global positioning, ‘Together, limitless’, positioning the move as a strategic milestone aimed at sharpening competitiveness and reinforcing its leadership pitch for what it called the “new intelligent age”. item.title: Shifali Singh to replace Dhruv Bogra as Forever New Country Director, India
item.description: New Delhi: Forever New today has appointed Shifali Singh as Country Director – India.
